messages:
maria_g: Quick sync — finalizing run-of-show & backups for the webinar I'm tentatively calling 'Serving for Product Teams: inference economics & graceful fallbacks'. Need: speaker availability, one pre-recorded demo fallback, rehearsal slot, and inbound lead routing. Target date: Tue Apr 28. Thoughts? :calendar:

alex_t: I'm good for Apr 28 afternoon PST. Can cover kernel selection + batching tradeoffs (15m). Will prepare 2 slides + 1 quick demo.

samir: Afternoon works for me too. I'll handle the demo and perf numbers. If live demo fails, we should have a 3-min pre-recorded clip. I can record tomorrow.

derek_p: Rehearsal availability: Mon Apr 27 10:00-11:00 PT or Mon 27 16:00 PT. Recommend we do a 45m tech run (slides + demo) and a 15m full run-of-show with ops.

emily_cs: Lead routing: please include this on the registration form: company size, cloud vs on-prem, primary use-case. Routing rule idea: tag leads with source=webinar and: if company_size>250 -> AE-midmarket queue; 50-249 -> SDR-enterprise; <50 -> SDR-PG. Also set lead priority if they select 'private deployment' or 'dedicated capacity'.

maria_g: Perfect. Alex/Samir — can you both confirm you have a short fallback demo clip by EOD tomorrow? We want something we can drop in <2m if live GPU instantiation or model fails.

alex_t: I'll record a 90s clip showing cached prefix path + batching improvement numbers. Will upload to drive and share link.

samir: I'll do a 2m clip of the demo run (local quantized model -> same prompt -> compare latency). Uploading to drive when done.

emily_cs: For follow-up cadence: 1) immediate thank-you email with recording + replay link 2) 24-48h tailored resource based on selected use-case 3) SDR outreach for high-priority tags. Can ops add utm params to registration link?

derek_p: Ops checklist for rehearsal / live:
```
- Verify staging model pinned version matches production fallback
- Warm GPU pool before the demo (15m pre-show)
- Redirect traffic in case of region outage -> fallback model in EU
- Recording capture + backup stream to S3
```

ops-bot: Reminder: rehearsal reminder scheduled for 2026-04-27T17:00:00Z (23 hours from now) :bell:

maria_g: Run-of-show (draft) — please comment inline or react :
```
00:00 - 00:05  Intro + housekeeping (maria)
00:05 - 00:20  Tech talk: kernel selection, batch strategy (alex)
00:20 - 00:35  Live demo + performance callouts (samir)
00:35 - 00:45  Q&A & panel (alex + samir + product)
00:45 - 00:50  CTA, resources, next steps (maria)
```

emily_cs: Add a slide with 'what to expect from Redwood Dedicated vs Private' and a short form CTA for a pilot request. Also, add a UTM param: utm_campaign=serving_product_2026

derek_p: Testing notes for Tuesday: we'll have a staging endpoint + a pre-warmed fallback variant. If staging returns >1.5s tail latency during demo, trigger the pre-recorded clip and switch audience to Q&A. Keep the switch script ready: '@maria_g — we're switching to the fallback clip due to a latency spike'

maria_g: Good. For roles: I'll host + handle Qs + CTA; Alex -> deep tech; Samir -> demo + metrics; Derek -> ops standby for switch; Emily -> capture lead rules & follow-up. Anyone else to add?

alex_t: All clear. Please send slide deck by EOD Mon so we can rehearse.

samir: Uploaded demo clip: https://drive.redwood/example/demo-clip.mp4 (private link) — can someone confirm access?

emily_cs: I can access. I'll prepare the registration form fields + routing rules and post the form draft here by EOD.

maria_g: Final action items: 1) Alex & Samir upload fallback clips by EOD tomorrow 2) Slides to maria by Mon EOD 3) Emily posts registration draft + routing rules 4) Derek confirms ops warm-up script. Rehearsal Mon Apr 27 10:00 PT (tentative). If any blockers, call it out now. :thumbsup:
